room_rent.note: Room rent capped at ₹2,000/day for SI options ₹50k, ₹1L, ₹2L; no room limit for SI above ₹2L. Basic plan SI starts at ₹5L so effectively no room limit for all available SI options.

icu.note: No ICU sub-limit mentioned for Basic plan.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment stated for Basic plan.

sub_limits.note: Ambulance capped at 1% of SI max ₹2,000/hosp; New Born Baby capped at 10% of SI max ₹50,000; no disease-wise sub-limits otherwise.

maternity.note: Maternity cover not available under Basic plan.

cumulative_bonus.note: Maximum cumulative bonus 50% under Basic plan; rate and reduction % not explicitly stated per year.

restoration.note: Automatic restoration of Base SI when Base SI and Cumulative Bonus exhausted/insufficient; available once per policy year; not applicable for RTA claims.

domiciliary.note: Covered up to SI; excludes listed conditions (asthma, diabetes, hypertension etc.).

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses covered; donor pre/post-hosp not covered.

modern_treatments.note: No explicit exclusion of modern/robotic treatments; covered under inpatient hospitalisation.

consumables.note: Consumables cover not available under Basic plan; available under Plus and Premiere.

global_cover.note: Global Hospitalisation cover not available under Basic plan.

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary excluded for asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy etc.; alcoholic cirrhosis permanent exclusion; impotency treatment; change-of-gender; adventure sports
optional_riders: Medical Second Opinion add-on, Flexi OP Care add-on (OPD cover)
